title: Choosing a messaging or notification service

kcs.statement: Use SQS to queue work for competing consumers that pull it when they are ready; use SNS to push a notification to multiple subscribers at the same moment.
Routing events from many AWS services or SaaS apps with filtering rules points to EventBridge; coordinating an ordered multi-step process with retries points to Step Functions.
A CloudWatch alarm notifies operators by publishing to an SNS topic, while customer-facing email at scale is sent with SES.

problem_ideas: Ten one-paragraph requirements, each answered by SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions or SES; name the closest distractor for each.
A billing alarm must text the finance lead: trace the path from CloudWatch to the phone.
An order system needs both buffering and fan-out: combine two services and justify.
Rank three designs for 'notify 5 microservices of each signup' by coupling.
A requirement says 'nightly at 01:00 trigger a report': which integration service and why not SNS?
Spot the wrong answer in a sample exam item where SES is offered for server alerts.
